# Reva Designs Frontend – Copilot Instructions

React 18 + Vite 6 + Tailwind 3 + shadcn/ui (JavaScript/JSX) storefront and admin panel for the Reva Designs Indian ethnic-wear store. Backend: sibling project `../reva_designs_server-main` (Express/MongoDB). Originally generated by Base44 (`@base44/*` packages, `base44` client name), but the data layer is a hand-written fetch client talking to that Express server.

Source code is the source of truth. Context docs in `.github/context/` are verified summaries; if they conflict with code, trust the code and fix the doc.

## Context routing (read before editing)

| Task | Read |
|---|---|
| "What is this system?" | `context/PROJECT_DNA.md` |
| Architecture, boundaries | `context/ARCHITECTURE.md` |
| UI, pages, components, state, styling, routing | `context/FRONTEND.md` |
| API calls, request/response shapes, flows | `context/API_AND_DATA_FLOW.md` (+ server repo's `.github/context/BACKEND.md` if the server must change) |
| Entities, orders, coupons, statuses | `context/BUSINESS_DOMAIN.md` |
| Tests / lint / typecheck | `context/TESTING.md` |
| Conventions, commands, anti-patterns | `context/WORKFLOW.md` |
| Why something is the way it is | `context/DECISION_LOG.md` |
| Recent work / open issues | `context/SESSION_JOURNAL.md` |

Multi-area tasks: read the combination. Example: new field on Product -> `FRONTEND.md` + `API_AND_DATA_FLOW.md` + `BUSINESS_DOMAIN.md` (+ server `models/Product.js`).

## Always follow

1. Search before creating. Reuse `src/components/ui/*` (shadcn), `ProductCard`, `cn()`/image helpers from `src/lib/utils.js`, and the `base44.entities.<Entity>` API in `src/api/base44Client.js`.
2. Match the page pattern: `useState` + `useEffect` loading via `base44.entities.*`, local `loading` skeletons, `sonner` `toast` for feedback. React Query is installed but barely used; do not migrate pages to it unprompted.
3. Use the `@/` alias for `src/`. Use Tailwind tokens (`bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`, `font-heading`, `font-body`) on the storefront; the admin panel uses hard-coded `slate-*`/`amber-*` dark classes.
4. Protect the API contract: field names are snake_case and must match server models and `entities/<Entity>` JSON files. Check `../reva_designs_server-main/models/`.
5. Never print or commit secrets. `.env` exists with `VITE_*` values; do not copy its values into code or docs.
6. Know the "Known gaps" in `FRONTEND.md` (no route guards, missing SDK methods, global cart, server ignores list filters) before assuming behavior; raise them rather than silently changing them.
7. Smallest complete change; no unrelated refactors; no new libraries or patterns unprompted.

## Validate changes

`npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`. Lint baseline has 5 unused-import errors; typecheck passes because `checkJs` is `false` in `jsconfig.json` (see `TESTING.md`); only ensure you add no new lint errors. There is no test runner.

## Keeping context current

Update the matching context doc in the same change when you invalidate it. Durable developer feedback: conventions -> `WORKFLOW.md`, decisions -> `DECISION_LOG.md`, UI patterns -> `FRONTEND.md`, business rules -> `BUSINESS_DOMAIN.md`, API behavior -> `API_AND_DATA_FLOW.md`. Keep `SESSION_JOURNAL.md` short.

`⚠ NEEDS HUMAN VERIFICATION` marks unconfirmed items; do not treat them as facts.
